name: Author-Ready Projects
purpose: The authoritative acceptance contract for Milestone 1. A feature is not complete merely because code exists; every required behavior must be validated here.

product_language.aesthetic: A cleanly organized trapper-keeper for a writing project: pages, typewriter, newsprint, folders, dividers, tabs, and notecards; never an IDE.
product_language.deletion: Archive by default. Permanent deletion is available only from Trash after an explicit irreversible warning.

acceptance.requirement: Launch to a project library with Create, Open, Recent Projects, and remove-from-recents without deleting files.
acceptance.method: Manual end-to-end validation.

acceptance.requirement: Create a new external project by name, location, type, and genre; scaffold documents, loom.json, Git, and an initial bookmark.
acceptance.method: Create in a temporary directory and inspect resulting files and history.

acceptance.requirement: Reopen a recent project after restarting Studio with tabs and last-open document restored as local app state, not project truth.
acceptance.method: Manual restart scenario.

acceptance.requirement: Validate loom.json against a versioned schema with useful human-readable errors.
acceptance.method: Automated valid/invalid fixture tests plus manual repair screen.

acceptance.requirement: Migrate older supported manifests and preserve a backup before writing changes.
acceptance.method: Automated migration fixture test.

acceptance.requirement: Offer a recoverable repair workflow for malformed or incomplete projects rather than crashing.
acceptance.method: Open malformed fixture and complete repair flow.

acceptance.requirement: Support first-class manuscript, scene, chapter, character, location, relationship, observation, world, note, and asset roles with stable IDs.
acceptance.method: Index mixed fixture and verify typed records.

acceptance.requirement: Edit schema fields through forms without requiring direct YAML editing while preserving unknown frontmatter fields.
acceptance.method: Automated round-trip test and manual form edit.

acceptance.requirement: Renaming or reordering a document preserves its stable identity and graph links.
acceptance.method: Automated rename/reorder test.

acceptance.requirement: Create, rename, duplicate, archive, restore, and permanently delete chapters/scenes with appropriate confirmation boundaries.
acceptance.method: Manual workflow plus filesystem tests.

acceptance.requirement: Drag-to-reorder manuscript items and persist order through frontmatter or manifest without exposing YAML.
acceptance.method: Manual drag validation and ordering tests.

acceptance.requirement: Autosave safely with visible state, crash recovery, stable cursor behavior, word count, search, and keyboard shortcuts.
acceptance.method: Manual editing matrix and automated recovery tests.

acceptance.requirement: Open multiple reference tabs; keep one visible; default to read-only; explicitly enter Edit; save or discard on exit.
acceptance.method: Manual reference-tab workflow.

acceptance.requirement: Render schema-backed character/reference forms with raw Markdown fallback and tolerant warning badges.
acceptance.method: Open valid and malformed reference fixtures.

acceptance.requirement: All normal delete actions move items to project Trash/archive without losing history.
acceptance.method: Automated archive/restore test.

acceptance.requirement: Permanent deletion is possible only from Trash after an explicit warning that recovery is impossible.
acceptance.method: Manual destructive-action confirmation validation.

acceptance.requirement: Create named bookmarks, browse bookmark history, preview restore, and go back safely with dirty-state handling.
acceptance.method: Automated repository test and manual history UI.

acceptance.requirement: Create, rename, switch, archive/delete, and identify the active timeline persistently using author language only.
acceptance.method: Automated Git wrapper tests and manual UI.

acceptance.requirement: Block switching with unbookmarked work and offer Bookmark and Switch.
acceptance.method: Automated dirty-state scenario and manual dialog.

acceptance.requirement: Derive documents, characters, scenes, POV, tags, appearances, locations, and relationship references.
acceptance.method: Automated graph fixture tests.

acceptance.requirement: Report duplicate IDs, broken links, missing characters, malformed frontmatter, and schema mismatches without crashing.
acceptance.method: Automated diagnostics fixture tests and manual health panel.

acceptance.requirement: External changes refresh safely without overwriting unsaved work or moving the cursor unexpectedly.
acceptance.method: Two-editor conflict matrix.

acceptance.requirement: The primary interface reads as an organized writer's binder/trapper-keeper, with tactile pages, tabs, dividers, folders, and notecards—not a developer tool.
acceptance.method: Visual review at desktop and narrow widths.

acceptance.requirement: No Git branch, commit, ref, hash, checkout, or conflict-marker terminology leaks into normal author workflows.
acceptance.method: UI text audit and error normalization tests.

acceptance.requirement: Real writing projects remain external or under ignored local workspace directories; Studio stores only path references and local UI state.
acceptance.method: Git-ignore audit and project creation test.
